candidate.role: immutable hidden-side volume and editable-topology starting point; never likeness authority

primary_trace.role: sole primary-view likeness and contour authority

topology_policy.initial: retain the dominant raw v05 component plus every non-trivial component intersecting the literal primary trace; no voxel remesh, quadriflow or automatic retopology

passes.acceptance: captures the unchanged dominant v05 component in the locked reference camera set

passes.primary_goal: make the leading drape read as one broad heavy form with intentional folds, rather than disconnected generated strips
passes.diagnostic_goal: retain positive thickness and avoid detached, intersecting or newly exposed geometry

passes.primary_goal: restore six distinct descending dorsal sac arcs without a flat shared roof
make thick support arches and ground contacts readable while keeping the tail subordinate

shape_gate.required_review: independent visual review after every deforming pass
rules: primary silhouette must not materially regress
the named pass defect must be visibly reduced in the locked primary view
no diagnostic view may expose a new detached, floating or self-intersecting major form
the result remains unaccepted and non-exportable until the 85-point final contour gate
